issues.problem: Cue (optional party invitation) and contexts 1-2 (tonight's drinks; 'don't have to go') fit 気が向かない / 気が向く (ky027) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote the cue as a specific request from the boss (a wedding speech), ctx1 as reluctance to go and see a particular person, ctx2 as 'you don't have to take it on'.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (合格して気が強くなった) is not clearly wrong: 気が強くなる is used for growing bolder, so the stated reason was shaky.
issues.action: Replaced it with このコーヒーは気が強い (meant: strong coffee), which is clearly wrong, since the idiom only describes a person's temperament.

issues.problem: Ctx1 translation said 'Mr Tanaka', a gender the Japanese doesn't give.
